newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HKFE forex hits record, exchange sets Easter hours.
newsitem.headline: HKFE forex hits record, exchange sets Easter hours.

text.p: The Hong Kong Futures Exchange (HKFE) said trading in its currency futures product, Rolling Forex, hit record volumes on March 4.
The HKFE said 7,849 contracts traded, representing about US$396 million in value, to surpass the previous record of 4,770 contracts set on February 26, the exchange said.
Of the record total, marks grabbed 4,137 contracts, yen tallied 3,581 contracts and STG notched 131 contracts.
The HKFE also announced special arrangements for trading Rolling Forex over Easter.
It said trading would close two hours earlier at 0200 HKT (1800 GMT) on the trading day starting March 27 and close on March 28.
Rolling Forex will resume trade on March 31, but no registered traders would be available to provide price quotations or respond to quote requests because of the Europe's close, the HKFE said.

The HKFE said the Rolling Forex market would close daily at 0300 HKT (1900 GMT) instead of 0400 HKT (2000 GMT) from April 7 account for daylight savings changes in the U.S. -- Hong Kong News Room (852) 2843 6358
